title: Full Stack Developer (Next.js / Node.js) – AI-Powered Development

* **Integrations:** Practical experience with Third-Party APIs, Payment Gateways, and OTP Services (Twilio, Firebase, Fast2SMS, etc.).
* **Database & Auth:** Experience with MongoDB / PostgreSQL, Prisma / Mongoose, JWT, and session management.
* **DevOps & Servers:** Sound knowledge of Linux environment, Nginx configuration, domain/DNS management, and server administration.

title: People Tech Application Engineer
description:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

  
  

The Company operates Snapchat , a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc. , a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji , Saturn, and other digital services.

  
  

The People Team drives Snap’s values of being kind, smart, and creative across our global workforce. We help teams hire thoughtful and passionate innovators, do their best work, grow their careers, and build healthy, productive workspaces in a safe and cohesive community.

  

We’re looking for a technical hands engineer for our newly formed application development team in India. The People tech team is building the next generation AI powered HR software suite for Snap and looking to accelerate the deployment of these transformative full-stack software solutions. This role is for a hands-on technical developer who can translate product management ideas, stakeholder needs, and People Team priorities into clear product designs, technical specifications, prototypes, executable engineering plans, and consumer-grade solutions.

  

This person will code, architect, and build. They will also be responsible for reviewing PRs and test plans, writing technical design documents, building, testing and deploying brand new solutions.

**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

* Translate product management ideas and business concepts into product designs, technical specifications, prototypes, and implementation plans.
* Partner across Product, People, HR Technology, IT, Security, Legal, Finance, and Engineering teams to understand requirements, evaluate trade-offs, and deliver solutions that support People Team products and services.
* Contribute directly to the codebase, developing production code, reviewing pull requests, and resolving complex technical issues, building and testing solutions.
* Architect scalable People Tech solutions that support internal tools, workflow automation, integrations, reporting, AI-enabled experiences, and operational processes.
* Own the quality of technical design by writing, reviewing, and approving technical design documents and PRs.
* Advocate for and apply best practices for availability, scalability, operational excellence, maintainability, cost management, and production support.
* Work closely with product and engineering teams to integrate AI, LLM, and chatbot solutions into People Tech systems where appropriate.
Design and develop middleware, APIs, services, and integrations across systems such as Slack, Workday, Jira, Confluence, internal People data services, and other enterprise platforms.  

  

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:**
----------------------------------

* Experience with backend services or distributed systems.
* Experience with database design and data modeling.
* Experience with event-driven architectures, including message queues, pub/sub systems, and asynchronous processing patterns.
* Experience designing and building RESTful APIs, webhooks, middleware, and integrations across multiple systems.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and deploying services to cloud environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with TypeScript, Node.js, SQL, and API integration patterns.
* Experience with Workday integrations, automations, and People data workflows.
* Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Slack, and other cloud-based services.
* Ability to translate ambiguous product or stakeholder requirements into product designs, technical specs, prototypes, and delivery plans.
* Ability to lead technical design for complex or cross-system initiatives.
* Ability to contribute directly to production code while also managing team delivery.
* Strong technical judgment and ability to make pragmatic architecture decisions.
* Ability to work independently without mature existing infrastructure or support.
* Proven track record of building applications from scratch.
* Ability to evaluate and apply AI/LLM capabilities responsibly in internal tools, workflow automation, and employee-facing experiences.

**Minimum Qualifications:**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent years of experience.
* 5+ years of experience in software engineering, application development, backend services, enterprise integrations, or related technical roles.
* Experience with Node.js, TypeScript, SQL, APIs, and cloud-based application development.
* Experience reviewing production code, technical designs, and test plans.
* Experience translating product requirements or ambiguous stakeholder needs into technical specifications and implementation plans.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
-----------------------------

* 6+ years of experience in software engineering, application development, backend services, enterprise integrations, or related technical roles.
* Experience building People Tech, HR Technology, Workday, internal tools, workflow automation, or enterprise platform solutions.
Experience with Spanner and GCP  

  
  
  
  
  

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please don’t be shy and provide us some information .

To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4+ days per week.

At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. EOE, including disability/vets.

Our Benefits : Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. title: Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer - DevOps & Technical Leadership
description:
**Location:** 100% Remote

**Employment:** Full-time, long-term position

**Start date:** As soon as possible after selection and agreement

**Salary:** Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with the potential for substantial growth during the first few years

**About Us**  
We are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects.

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We work with external developers and specialists, and we need strong technical leadership to turn their contributions into reliable, maintainable software.

AI-assisted and agentic development are central to how we work. We want to move quickly, make sensible technical decisions, and build solutions that our team can understand, operate, and improve.

We are looking for an experienced engineer who wants to join at an early stage, take meaningful responsibility, and grow with the company.

**Job Description**  
We are seeking a Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer who can develop applications across frontend and backend, integrate AI capabilities, and manage the Linux infrastructure, databases, and deployment processes supporting them.

You should be comfortable taking a project from an initial business requirement through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will work across different products and internal initiatives, helping us choose practical solutions and deliver them efficiently.

Alongside hands-on engineering, your responsibilities may include leading developers, mentoring less experienced colleagues, coordinating outsourced contributors, and reviewing externally delivered work. Previous team leadership and mentoring experience are therefore important.

This is an opportunity to help establish the engineering foundations of a growing startup and develop into a broader technical leadership position.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend.
* Build AI-powered features, integrations, internal tools, and business automations.
* Use AI coding assistants and coding agents effectively, with appropriate testing and human review.
* Translate business requirements into clear implementation tasks and verifiable acceptance criteria.
* Design APIs, business logic, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations.
* Manage database schemas, migrations, query performance, backups, and recovery procedures.
* Administer Linux servers, including application services, permissions, updates, networking, and troubleshooting.
* Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks.
* Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies.
* Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners.
* Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification.
* Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes.
* Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies.
* Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback.
* Keep implementation proportionate to the problem, controlling unnecessary complexity, infrastructure costs, and maintenance overhead.

**Required Qualifications**

  

* Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production web applications.
* Strong frontend development skills using a modern framework, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling.
* Practical experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into software, including checking output quality, handling failures, and managing latency and usage costs.
* Substantial hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic development workflows, with examples of working results you independently verified.
* Strong SQL and relational database experience, including migrations, indexing, performance analysis, and backup and recovery.
* Hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience.
* A working understanding of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, ports, and reverse proxies.
* Practical CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and familiarity with Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and build agents.
* Strong Git, pull-request, code-review, and release-management skills.
* Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery.
* Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly.
* Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams.
* The ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and make sound decisions with a limited startup budget.
* Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility.

**Especially Valuable Experience**

  

* Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup.
* Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time.
* Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness.
* Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation.
* Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments.
* Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation.
* Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring.

**Growth, Responsibility and Compensation**  
Joining at this stage offers the opportunity to influence how we build software, organize delivery, and develop our engineering team.

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years.

For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment.

**What We Offer**

  

* A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
* Direct involvement in technical decisions across multiple products and initiatives.
* The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team.
* Broad ownership across software, AI integration, infrastructure, and delivery.
* Close collaboration with startup leadership.
* The potential for significant career and compensation growth as the company develops.

**Remote Working Arrangement**  
Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

**How to Apply**  
We are looking to fill this core engineering role promptly. Applying early gives us the opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our technical direction from the beginning.

Please submit your CV and a short overview covering:

* A production application you helped deliver and your own frontend and backend contributions.
* An AI feature or agentic workflow you implemented and how you verified its results.
* Your Linux, Docker, database, and deployment responsibilities.
* A team you led or developers you mentored, including the outcomes.
* Your experience coordinating outsourced development and reviewing external deliverables.
* Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account.

Public portfolio links and GitHub repositories are welcome. Please do not share confidential customer information or credentials.

### **Job Description**

**Technical Lead – AI Solutions & GTM (Voice AI · RAG · Full Stack)**

**Location:** Okhla Phase-I | Work from office

**Experience:** 7+ years

**About Mobiloitte Group**

Mobiloitte Group is a technology group headquartered in Delhi, India, with entities in the USA, UK, UAE, Singapore and South Africa. The group builds AI-first products and delivers enterprise engineering for clients across these markets. Its flagship product, Converiqo.AI, is a multi-tenant AI customer-engagement platform. It runs conversations, automation and outbound campaigns across WhatsApp, web chat, Instagram, Messenger, Telegram, SMS and voice, for businesses in India, the USA, the UAE and South Africa.

**About the Role**

This is the engineer our customers meet. You will be the technical face of Converiqo.AI in sales conversations:

* Running discovery with the prospect

* Building the demo on the prospect's own data

* Designing the deployment

* Committing to numbers you can defend

Then you will lead the team that delivers it.

  
  

It is a hands-on role. You will write production code, review your team's code, and debug live systems. We are not looking for a pre-sales speaker without build depth, nor for an engineer who cannot face a client.

**Not a fit:** experience limited to prompt engineering, wrapping third-party AI APIs, or configuring no-code voice/chatbot platforms without building the pipeline underneath.

**What You Will Do**

**Go-to-market and solutioning**

* Run technical discovery with prospects. Map their use cases to platform capabilities and call out gaps honestly.
* Build live demos and time-boxed proofs of concept on client data, such as knowledge-base ingestion, WhatsApp flows and voice agents, in days rather than weeks.
* Design solution architecture for client deployments:

o dedicated stack per customer

o cloud, VPC or on-premises hosting, and data residency

o integration with CRMs, e-commerce stores (WooCommerce, Shopify) and telephony

* Own the technical sections of proposals, RFPs, SOWs, security questionnaires and data-processing agreements. This includes sizing, latency and cost-per-conversation estimates, and SLAs.
* Bring field learnings and competitor teardowns back into the product roadmap.

**Build and deliver**

* **Voice AI:** build streaming STT LLM/RAG TTS pipelines with barge-in, endpointing, SIP/telephony and WebSockets. Implement outbound calling controls: consent, Do-Not-Call, calling windows and emergency stop.
* **RAG:** cover document parsing, chunking quality, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking, and grounding and citations. Make sure the system says "I don't know" when it should, and keep evaluation sets that catch regressions.
* **Agents:** build bounded agentic workflows using LangGraph, MCP or equivalent. Have the judgement to keep agent loops off latency-critical paths.
* **Private LLMs:** deploy Llama, Qwen, Mistral or similar on vLLM, TensorRT-LLM or Ollama. Handle GPU/VRAM sizing, quantization, concurrency, and routing between hosted and self-hosted models.
* **Cost and performance:** per-turn token and cost metering, latency budgets, caching, observability and alerting.
* **Security:** tenant isolation, PII encryption, role-based access, secrets management and webhook signature verification.

**Lead**

* Lead a 25+ engineering team: architecture decisions, code reviews, merging module-scoped work, and engineering standards.
* Use AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex or similar) productively. Scope the work tightly, review the output, and verify against the code rather than the agent's report.
* Mentor engineers and leave written decisions behind.

**Must Have**

* 7+ years in software engineering, with at least 2 years shipping LLM features used by real customers in production.
* Personally built and run in production at least one of: a voice bot, an enterprise RAG system, or a self-hosted LLM deployment. Two or more is strongly preferred.
* Strong Python (FastAPI or similar) and PostgreSQL, plus working proficiency in TypeScript with React / Next.js.
* Docker, CI/CD, and at least one of AWS, Azure or GCP. Kubernetes is a plus.
* Client-facing experience in discovery, demos, PoCs or solution design, and the ability to explain trade-offs to both CXOs and engineers.
* Clear written English for proposals and architecture documents.
* Evidence-driven: you measure quality and latency with numbers, not impressions.

**Good to Have**

* WhatsApp Business Platform / Meta Cloud API; Instagram and Messenger APIs.
* Vector databases (Qdrant, pgvector, Milvus, Weaviate) and Redis.
* Telephony and real-time media: Twilio, Plivo, Exotel, Asterisk / FreeSWITCH, LiveKit or Pipecat.
* Hindi / Hinglish and other Indian-language STT and TTS.
* Compliance exposure: India's DPDP Act, TRAI telemarketing rules, GDPR, SOC 2.
* Replacing public LLM APIs with self-hosted models in production.
* E-commerce integrations and AI shopping assistants.
* Open-source contributions in the AI / voice space.

### **Requirements**

* voicebots
* chatbots
